paragraphs.zh: 1.66g偶氮二异丁腈(99％、0.01mol)，33.75g氢溴酸(48％、0.2mol)加入500ml反应瓶中，在60～65℃滴加22.7g双氧水(30％、0.2mol)，滴加完毕后继续反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后分层，有机层水洗、浓缩，乙醇进行重结晶、过滤、烘干得30.66g白色粉末，纯度98.8％，收率88.7％。
paragraphs.en: 1.66 g of azobisisobutyronitrile (99%, 0.01 mol) and 33.75 g of hydrobromic acid (48%, 0.2 mol) are charged into a 500 ml reaction flask; 22.7 g of hydrogen peroxide (30%, 0.2 mol) is added dropwise at 60 to 65 C, and after the addition is complete the reaction is continued and followed by LC until the reaction is complete. After the reaction is complete the layers are separated, the organic layer is washed with water and concentrated, recrystallised from ethanol, filtered and dried to give 30.66 g of a white powder, purity 98.8%, yield 88.7%.
paragraphs.notes: Orphan block at the very top of the page: no [00NN] marker is printed above it. It is the tail of the paragraph that begins on the previous page. The marker [0073] is NOT visible on p10; it is carried over from p09, whose text layer ends '[0073]  将26.43g  2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(99.7％、0.1mol)，200ml氯仿，' with no further marker, so this text is the continuation of [0073]. Recorded as an attribution, not as something printed here. This paragraph completes step 1 of the worked example (the benzylic bromination), whose heading [0071] is on p09. Reagent arithmetic is internally consistent: AIBN MW 164.21 x 0.01 / 0.99 = 1.66 g; HBr MW 80.91 x 0.2 / 0.48 = 33.7 g; H2O2 MW 34.01 x 0.2 / 0.30 = 22.7 g; and 30.66 g at 98.8% of the C10H10BrClO4S bromide (MW 341.6) is 0.0887 mol, i.e. 88.7% on 0.1 mol, matching the printed yield exactly. Note the oxidant system here is HBr/H2O2 with AIBN, not elemental bromine. TRANSCRIPTION PROVENANCE FOR THIS WHOLE PAGE: every zh field was taken from the PDF's own embedded text layer (CN109678767A is born digital; all 11 pages carry a real text layer), NOT read off pixels by a model. No character was OCR'd or guessed. Whitespace convention, applied uniformly: (a) hard line-wrap breaks in the extracted text are joined with no character inserted; (b) the extractor emits a spurious space before the decimal point or before a locant comma in some numeric literals ('30 .66g', '1 .13g', '31 .1g', '34 .72g', '(99 .8%', '0 .1mol', '0 .74g', '0 .01mol', '0 .2mol', '22 .6g', '(2 ,2 ,2-', '1 ,3-'). The printed page shows every one of those literals unbroken, each one inspected on a crop enlarged 2x to 3x, so those spaces are a PDF kerning artifact and have been removed - leaving them in would corrupt the number for any downstream mass-balance parser. The raw extractor form of each affected token is listed in discrepancies so the change is fully recoverable. (c) Genuine wide gaps that separate a Latin/digit run from the next token ('34.2g  2-', '200ml  DMF', '34.72g  2-', '0.74g  DMF', '22.6g  1,3-') are visible in the image AND present in the text layer, and are preserved verbatim as the extractor records them, namely a no-break space U+00A0 followed by an ordinary space U+0020, in all five places they occur: '34.2g<NBSP> 2-', '200ml<NBSP> DMF', '34.72g<NBSP> 2-', '0.74g<NBSP> DMF' and '22.6g<NBSP> 1,3-'. Nothing else was normalised: full-width punctuation, half-width parentheses, the full-width percent sign and the full-width tilde are all as extracted.

paragraphs.zh: 2、2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成
paragraphs.notes: Step heading for step 2 of the worked example. The step number is printed as '2、' with the ideographic enumeration comma. Parentheses around the trifluoroethoxy locants are half-width '(' and ')' in the text layer, unlike the reference patent CN104292137A which prints them asymmetrically; reproduced as extracted. The heading names the product as the free ACID (苯甲酸), which matches both the structure drawn in the [0075] slot and the end of [0076].

Drawing slot. The marker [0075] is printed alone at the left margin, vertically centred against a single drawn structure that occupies the full width of the text block. No text follows the marker. The structure is recorded as drawings[0].

paragraphs.zh: 将34.2g  2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(99.8％、0.1mol)，27.88g碳酸钾(99％、0.2mol)，2.26g三乙烯二胺(99％、0.01mol)，200ml  DMF，1.13g2,2,2-三氟乙醇(99％、0.2mol)加入500ml反应瓶中，在20～25℃进行反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完毕后过滤，滤液浓缩。往剩余物里8.1g氢氧化钠(99％、0.2mol)，200ml水，在70～75℃进行碱解，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后滴加盐酸酸化，过滤，洗涤，烘干得31.1g白色粉末，纯度99.5％，收率89.3％。
paragraphs.en: 34.2 g of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate (99.8%, 0.1 mol), 27.88 g of potassium carbonate (99%, 0.2 mol), 2.26 g of triethylenediamine (99%, 0.01 mol), 200 ml of DMF and 1.13 g of 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol (99%, 0.2 mol) are charged into a 500 ml reaction flask and reacted at 20 to 25 C, followed by LC until the reaction is complete. After the reaction is finished the mixture is filtered and the filtrate is concentrated. Into the residue, 8.1 g of sodium hydroxide (99%, 0.2 mol) and 200 ml of water; alkaline hydrolysis is carried out at 70 to 75 C, followed by LC until the reaction is complete. After the reaction is complete, hydrochloric acid is added dropwise to acidify, and the product is filtered, washed and dried to give 31.1 g of a white powder, purity 99.5%, yield 89.3%.
paragraphs.notes: 三乙烯二胺 is triethylenediamine, i.e. DABCO (1,4-diazabicyclo[2.2.2]octane); it is NOT 三乙胺 (triethylamine), which appears separately in [0079]. Verified character by character in the text layer and at 3x magnification on the image: the character 烯 is present. Two reagent figures in this paragraph are arithmetically inconsistent with their printed molar amounts and are flagged in discrepancies; both are transcribed exactly as printed and neither has been corrected. The clause '往剩余物里8.1g氢氧化钠(99％、0.2mol)，200ml水' has no verb (no 加入 or equivalent after 里); the English keeps the same elliptical construction rather than supplying one. 碱解 rendered as 'alkaline hydrolysis' (saponification of the methyl ester to the free acid). Product mass checks out: 31.1 g at 99.5% of the C11H10ClF3O5S acid (MW 346.7) is 0.0893 mol, i.e. 89.3% on 0.1 mol, matching the printed yield. The wide gaps in '34.2g  2-氯' and '200ml  DMF' are real and preserved; '1.13g2,2,2-三氟乙醇' has NO gap between the mass and the compound name on the printed page, inspected on a 3x crop, and none has been inserted.

环磺酮 is the Chinese common name for tembotrione. Note it is 环磺酮, three characters, NOT 环磺草酮 (four characters) as used in the reference patent CN104292137A; transcribed as printed. The identification of 环磺酮 with tembotrione is corroborated on this page by the structure drawn in the [0078] slot, which is read independently off the drawing in drawings[1] and is not derived from the name.
Drawing slot. The marker [0078] is printed alone at the left margin, vertically centred against a single drawn structure. No text follows the marker. The structure is recorded as drawings[1].

paragraphs.zh: 将34.72g  2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸(99.8％、0.1mol)，0.74g  DMF(99％、0.01mol)，24g氯化亚砜(99％、0.2mol)，100ml二氯乙烷加入250ml反应瓶中，升温回流反应，反应完毕后脱尽溶剂。将22.6g  1,3-环己二酮(99％、0.2mol)、100ml二氯甲烷加入反应瓶，在5～10℃滴加30.6g三乙胺(99％、0.3mol)，LC跟踪至反应完全。反应完全后，加入0.89g丙酮氰醇(95％、0.01mol)，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后加入水进行水洗，分层，油层脱尽溶剂，加乙醇进行重结晶，过滤，烘干得38.1g米黄色结晶粉末，纯度98.7％，收率85.4％。
paragraphs.en: 34.72 g of 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid (99.8%, 0.1 mol), 0.74 g of DMF (99%, 0.01 mol), 24 g of thionyl chloride (99%, 0.2 mol) and 100 ml of dichloroethane are charged into a 250 ml reaction flask; the temperature is raised and the mixture is reacted at reflux, and after the reaction is finished the solvent is stripped off completely. 22.6 g of 1,3-cyclohexanedione (99%, 0.2 mol) and 100 ml of dichloromethane are charged into the reaction flask, and 30.6 g of triethylamine (99%, 0.3 mol) is added dropwise at 5 to 10 C, followed by LC until the reaction is complete. After the reaction is complete, 0.89 g of acetone cyanohydrin (95%, 0.01 mol) is added, followed by LC until the reaction is complete. After the reaction is complete, water is added and the mixture is washed with water and the layers separated; the oil layer is stripped of solvent completely, ethanol is added for recrystallisation, and the product is filtered and dried to give 38.1 g of a beige crystalline powder, purity 98.7%, yield 85.4%.
paragraphs.notes: 丙酮氰醇 is acetone cyanohydrin, the conventional cyanide-source catalyst for the enol-ester to triketone (Fries-type) rearrangement; verified character by character. It is NOT 氰基丙酮 (cyanoacetone), which is what the reference patent CN104292137A prints at the equivalent step. 1,3-环己二酮 carries an explicit 1,3- locant here, unlike CN104292137A which writes only 环己二酮. 二氯乙烷 in the first stage and 二氯甲烷 in the second are two different solvents and have not been merged. Every reagent figure in this paragraph is arithmetically consistent with its printed molar amount: acid MW 346.7 x 0.1 / 0.998 = 34.74 g; DMF MW 73.09 x 0.01 / 0.99 = 0.74 g; SOCl2 MW 118.97 x 0.2 / 0.99 = 24.0 g; 1,3-cyclohexanedione MW 112.13 x 0.2 / 0.99 = 22.65 g; Et3N MW 101.19 x 0.3 / 0.99 = 30.7 g; acetone cyanohydrin MW 85.10 x 0.01 / 0.95 = 0.90 g; and 38.1 g at 98.7% of tembotrione (C17H16ClF3O6S, MW 440.8) is 0.0853 mol, i.e. 85.3% on 0.1 mol, matching the printed 85.4% within rounding. The enol-ester intermediate that the acid chloride and 1,3-cyclohexanedione must form before the acetone cyanohydrin step is neither named nor drawn anywhere on this page; that gap is in the source, not in the transcription. 米黄色 rendered literally as beige (rice-yellow). Note the acid charge is 0.1 mol against 0.2 mol of the diketone, a 2-fold excess of diketone.

Section heading. IMPORTANT for attribution: everything ABOVE this line on p10, including both drawn structures, belongs to the invention's own worked example; the comparative example starts here and its first step heading is [0081], with its body running onto the next page. Nothing drawn on p10 is part of the comparative example.

drawings.notes: Single structure, no arrows, no reagents, no plus signs: this is a product depiction under a step heading, not a scheme. Ring substitution pattern was read directly off the drawing at 2x magnification: starting from the COOH-bearing vertex and walking clockwise, the immediately adjacent vertex carries Cl, the next carries CH2OCH2CF3, the next carries SO2CH3, and the remaining two vertices are unsubstituted, giving the contiguous 1,2,3,4 pattern. Kekule double bonds are drawn inside the ring. The sulfonyl is drawn in expanded form (S with two S=O), so it is unambiguously a sulfone SO2CH3 and not a sulfoxide or sulfonate. The trifluoroethoxymethyl arm is drawn as a collapsed text label, so its internal connectivity (CH2-O-CH2-CF3) is read from the label characters rather than from bonds; the label is crisp and unambiguous. This structure matches the compound named in heading [0074] exactly, and it is the product of step 2 of the invention's worked example, so it is the invention's own route and not prior art and not the comparative example, which does not begin until [0080] further down the page.

drawings.notes: Single structure, no arrows: a product depiction under step heading [0077], not a scheme. TAUTOMER AS DRAWN: the diketo form is drawn, with both ring carbonyls as full C=O double bonds and C2 as an sp3 vertex bearing an implicit H; the enol tautomer usually shown for this herbicide class is NOT what is on the page, and the SMILES records the diketo form as drawn. The bridging carbonyl is drawn between the cyclohexanedione C2 and the benzene ring, so this is one molecule and not two separate species; there is no plus sign and no arrow anywhere in the drawing. The aryl substitution pattern was read at 2x magnification by walking from the vertex bonded to the bridging carbonyl: adjacent vertex carries Cl, next carries CH2OCH2CF3, next carries SO2CH3, remaining two are unsubstituted. The aryl fragment is identical to the one in drawings[0], which is exactly what the route requires, but it was read off this drawing independently and not copied from the first. The compound corresponds to tembotrione, matching the name 环磺酮 in heading [0077], but the identification here rests on the drawing. Attribution: the invention's own worked example; the comparative example does not begin until [0080], below this drawing.

discrepancies.what: Text-vs-text, chemically significant. In [0076] the mass printed for triethylenediamine (DABCO) does not correspond to the molar amount printed beside it.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - not a drawing issue; drawings[0] on this page depicts only the product of [0076] and says nothing about reagent charges
discrepancies.text_says: [0076] prints '2.26g三乙烯二胺(99％、0.01mol)'. Triethylenediamine (DABCO) MW 112.17, so 0.01 mol at 99% purity is 1.13 g, not 2.26 g; 2.26 g corresponds to 0.02 mol. Transcribed exactly as printed and NOT corrected. Downstream mass-balance passes must treat the mass and the mole figure for this reagent as mutually inconsistent and pick one deliberately rather than silently.

discrepancies.what: Text-vs-text, chemically significant. In [0076] the mass printed for 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol is roughly 18-fold below the molar amount printed beside it, and it is the limiting-reagent line of the step.
discrepancies.text_says: [0076] prints '1.13g2,2,2-三氟乙醇(99％、0.2mol)'. 2,2,2-Trifluoroethanol MW 100.04, so 0.2 mol at 99% purity is 20.2 g, not 1.13 g; 1.13 g corresponds to about 0.011 mol, i.e. only 0.11 equivalent against the 0.1 mol of benzylic bromide, which cannot support the printed 89.3% yield. Recorded as a factual observation and NOT acted on: the value 1.13 g is exactly the mass that 0.01 mol of triethylenediamine at 99% would require, and 2.26 g in the preceding clause is exactly 0.02 mol of triethylenediamine, so the two masses look transposed or otherwise garbled at typesetting. No substitution has been made in the transcription; the printed characters stand.
